content.title: No Surprises In Lattice Semiconductor’s (NASDAQ:LSCC) Q3 Sales Numbers But Stock Drops
content.summary: Semiconductor designer Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ:LSCC) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 4.9% year on year to $133.3 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $143 million, coming in 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.28 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
